<thought>Using the high‑resolution ESI‑MS data, the monoisotopic ion at m/z 141.115364 matches the exact mass of C₈H₁₅NO (C = 8 × 12.0000, H = 15 × 1.007825, N = 14.003074, O = 15.994915). This formula fits the observed isotopic pattern (≈9 % M+1 from ~8 carbons) and gives an exact mass identical to the measured value.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H15NO</final_answer>
